name: octaweave_create_event
description: Create a calendar event. `starts_at` is RFC-3339 and required; `ends_at` defaults to a one-hour event. Pass `rrule` (an iCalendar RRULE, e.g. 'FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU') to make it repeat. Omit `calendar` to use the workspace's default calendar.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

ends_at.description: End, RFC-3339. Defaults to one hour after the start.

rrule.description: Optional iCalendar RRULE to repeat the event.
